newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nokia-Maillefer to buy Italian firm.
newsitem.headline: Nokia-Maillefer to buy Italian firm.

text.p: Nokia-Maillefer Holding SA, a leading world supplier of power and telephone cable manufacturing systems, said it had signed a letter of intent to buy Dolci Extrusion S.P.A. of Milan.
Dolci is an engineering company with 1996 sales of 37 million Swiss francs and a workforce of 130, Nokia-Maillefer said in a statement.
Nokia-Maillefer did not disclose the price but said the purchase was aimed at strengthening its competence in machinery for manufacturing plastic film.
"Nokia-Maillefer's strategy is to strengthen its position as technology and market leader in plastics extrusion manufacturing systems," Nokia-Maillefer president Jaako Asantios said.
